tasks.title: Add User entity and repository with hashed password storage
tasks.description: Create the user table/entity (id, name, unique email, password hash) and a repository. Hash passwords with a one-way, salted algorithm (e.g. bcrypt) before persisting; never store plain text. Keep the hash out of serialised output and logs. Covers: stored password differs from the submitted one and is a hash.

tasks.title: Implement user registration endpoint with validation
tasks.description: Add a POST registration endpoint in the Quarkus app accepting name, email and password. Validate that all three are present and non-blank and that the email is well-formed. Reject duplicate emails (status code pending PO answer). Return a response DTO that excludes the password and hash. Covers: success status on valid registration, no password or hash in any response.

tasks.title: Add REST Assured tests for registration
tasks.description: Using the existing JUnit 5 + REST Assured setup, test: successful registration, password stored as a hash and not equal to the plain text, response body free of password and hash, missing/blank/malformed field rejection, and duplicate email handling.
